description: Temurin SBOM validation stage parameters. This stage clones temurin-build and delegates to tooling/validateSBOM.sh.

parameterGroups.name: SBOM Validation Options
parameterGroups.description: Controls which temurin-build revision is used to obtain the validateSBOM.sh tool. Defaults to the same repository and branch used by the build stage.

parameters.name: TEMURIN_BUILD_REPO
parameters.description: temurin-build repository URL used to obtain validateSBOM.sh. Empty = uses the script default (https://github.com/adoptium/temurin-build.git).

parameters.name: TEMURIN_BUILD_BRANCH
parameters.description: temurin-build branch used to obtain validateSBOM.sh. Empty = uses the script default (master).
